description.value:
Duration constant

Your death or permanent removal from play cannot happen as an incidental consequence. It requires a deliberate, foreshadowed act by a named antagonist, or your own informed choice — the GM tells you plainly when such a threat is present, before it resolves. Mechanically: any effect that would kill or permanently remove you without that setup instead leaves you dying 1 at the scene's edge, and the story continues.
